title: exacum pedunculatum var. petiolare
intro: Exacum pedunculatum var. petiolare, commonly known as the Japanese gentian, is a plant species within the gentian family (Gentianaceae). It is valued for its medicinal properties, which include potential health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial effects, helping to alleviate symptoms of anxiety and insomnia. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its antioxidant and immunomodulatory effects. Further research is needed to fully understand the therapeutic applications and bioactive constituents of Exacum pedunculatum var. petiolare.
